title: Escaping the Anthropomorphic Trap: Resolving the Cognitive Mismatch in Future AI Software Development
abstract: arXiv:2611.23264v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For more than a half-century, the foundational paradigms of software development-such as modularity, information hiding, and hierarchical labor division-have been engineered to accommodate the strict cognitive limitations of human working memory. However, the rapid emergence of multi-agent artificial intelligence exposes a fundamental cognitive mismatch. Current frameworks attempt to integrate high-dimensional, stateless neural reasoning engines by coercing them to operate within these legacy, human-centric structures, falling into an anthropomorphic trap. This friction generates a novel, highly volatile behavioral entropy defined as AI-software technical debt, wherein amnesic agents hallucinate opaque workarounds to bypass architectural blindfolds. translated_title: 逃离拟人化陷阱：解决未来AI软件开发中的认知错配问题
translated_abstract: 半个多世纪以来，软件开发的基础范式——如模块化、信息隐藏和分层劳动分工——都是为了适应人类工作记忆的严格认知限制而设计的。然而，多智能体人工智能的迅速崛起暴露出一种根本性的认知错配。当前框架试图整合高维、无状态的神经推理引擎，却强迫它们在这些遗留的、以人为中心的结构中运行，从而陷入了拟人化陷阱。这种摩擦产生了一种新颖且高度不稳定的行为熵，我们将其定义为“AI-软件技术债务”——即健忘的智能体为绕过架构盲区而产生不透明的变通方案。为解决这一问题，我们提出了“隐形软件工程”（Invisible SE），这是一种从以智能体为中心的人类模拟向以环境为中心的共识调控治理的范式转变。通过重新构想……
tldr: 论文指出传统以人类认知为中心的软件开发范式与多智能体AI存在根本性认知错配，由此产生“AI-软件技术债务”，并提出“隐形软件工程”这一新范式，实现从智能体模仿人类向以环境为中心的共识调控治理的转变。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals a fundamental cognitive mismatch between human-centric software engineering paradigms and multi-agent AI—causing "AI-software technical debt"—and proposes "Invisible Software Engineering (Invisible SE)" as a paradigm shift from agent-centric human emulation to environment-centric stigmergic governance.
